gaps.explanation: Re-read pp4-10. Nothing printed is missing and nothing is counted twice. Exhibit E (p4) Total Revenues 12,735,167 = General 7,624,388 + Street 2,226,960 + Capital Projects 3,055 + Debt Service 2,215,062 + Other Governmental 665,702. Detail: General Exhibit P (p10) 7,624,388, nonmajor Exhibit O (p9) 665,702, Capital Projects Interest 3,055 (p4 column) tie; Street and Debt Service only from Exhibit L (p8, budgetary). Street: 1,034,561 + 73,548 + 167,871 + 727,912 + 240,003 = 2,243,895 vs p4 2,226,960 (schedule 16,935 above). Debt Service: 1,138,419 + 15,236 + 351,920 + 50,053 = 1,555,628 vs p4 2,215,062 (659,434 short; p4 prints Special Assessments 569,610, Intergovernmental 131,952, Interest 31,111, Misc 86,804 grouped differently on the budget schedule; Exhibit L also prints 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791, in detail as other financing). 659,434 - 16,935 = 642,499 = the gap. Adding p4 Street/Debt Service rows would count those funds twice. JSON statement lines equal p4.

p4 Total Expenditures 14,444,698 = General 7,642,913 + Street 1,067,340 + Capital Projects 2,716,630 + Debt Service 2,488,117 + Other Governmental 529,698. General (pp11-14), nonmajor (p9) and Capital Projects (p4 column) tie. Street: Exhibit L (p8) Streets 999,976 + Capital Outlay 63,194 = 1,063,170 vs p4 1,067,340 (4,170 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L prints Capital Outlay 128,664 (in detail) and the rest as 'Other Financing Uses' 2,353,225 (in detail, other financing, label as printed) vs p4 General Government 40,397 + Lease Payments 10,737 + Bond Payments 2,308,319 = 2,359,453 beyond the capital outlay. 4,170 + 2,359,453 = 2,363,623 = the gap. That spending is inside the 2,353,225 line (cannot be split); adding p4 rows would count it twice.

p4 Transfers In 1,870,308 = Capital Projects 1,600,931 (in detail) + Debt Service 269,377. Debt Service's Exhibit L (p8) prints no transfer row; its inflows are 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791 (in detail) vs p4 Debt Service Transfers In 269,377 + Loan Proceeds 128,664 = 398,041. The 269,377 is inside that line (cannot be split). Gap 269,377.

p4 Transfers Out (1,870,308) = General (250,327) + Street (1,619,981). General Fund transfers out in detail (pp11-14) 250,328 (1 rounding). Street's 1,619,981 is in detail as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Uses' -1,619,981 (same amount, printed label kept). 1,619,981 - 1 = 1,619,980 = the gap. Nothing missing.

p4 debt proceeds 1,328,664 = Capital Projects Bond Proceeds 1,200,000 (in detail) + Debt Service Loan Proceeds 128,664. The loan proceeds are inside Debt Service's Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Sources' 925,791 detail line (cannot be split). Schedule figure 1,212,223 = 1,200,000 + Insurance Proceeds 6,220 (General, p10) + 4,706 (Capital Projects, p4) + Bond Premiums 1,297 (p4), the last three being other_financing, not debt. 1,212,223 - 12,223 + 128,664 = 1,328,664. Street Insurance Proceeds 1,528 (p4) not added: Street's detail is Exhibit L, whose Street 'Other Financing Sources' actual is '-', so on that basis the receipt sits in a resources row already in detail.
